summary:
Fixed and verified.

**The needle** was an off-by-one array-slice bug in `processor.py:17`:

```python
end = start + batch_size - 1   # ❌ dropped the last item of every batch
```

Python slices are end-exclusive, so `records[start:end]` returned only `batch_size - 1` records per batch. With 25 records in batches of 10, three batches each silently dropped one record. The comment ("grab exactly batch_size items") described the intent, but the `- 1` contradicted it.

Fix:

```python
end = start + batch_size   # ✅ slice end is exclusive
```

`./test.sh` now passes all four cases (full batches, exact boundary, uneven division, and ID-sequence integrity).
